thread:
zoe (prod): Heads up: Large ecommerce customer asked for a tenant-level pin feature and a generous deprecation runway (8-10 months). They want console + API control and a hard SLA for parity during migration.
arjun (eng): Tenant-level pin is doable. We need to decide data model: per-catalog-entry pinned_tenants list vs tenant-scoped pin entry. First option costs more storage for big catalogs.
mira (eng-ml): From bench side we need their golden prompt set. If they provide it (1k prompts) we can run diff metrics. Suggest auto-fallback if quality drops >1% and latency increase >25ms.
nate (cs): They want manual signoff on quality, not auto-fallback. Also want migration credits and console visibility for pin expiry.
ada (legal): We should add a pin-exception clause: emergency rollback allowed for safety/security incidents, and a limited liability carveout for performance regressions if they override our recommended migration.
arjun (eng): Ops concerns: pinned tenants should be excluded from global canaries and bulk swap jobs. We'll add routing precedence: check tenant_pin -> pinned_model -> default routing. Also rate-limit any mass actions touching pinned tenants.
mira (eng-ml): Implementation for evals: store tenant benchmark bundles as JSONL in S3 with metadata (seed, expected labels). Bench-runner will produce a report with precision/recall and latency deltas.
zoe (prod): Proposed acceptance criteria to offer customer: (1) tenant-provided eval bundle run by us; (2) p95 latency delta <= +35ms OR they accept migration credit payment; (3) quality deltas within 1% or manual signoff; (4) pin TTL 9 months max with auto-notify at 180d/60d/14d/7d.
nate (cs): They will push for p95 +15ms. Can we tie lower delta to higher migration credit?
arjun (eng): Yes. Also we should offer an API for pin management + audit log entries. Schema change: add tenant_pin boolean and pin_expires_at timestamp on tenant_catalog table (or separate tenant_pin table). Low-risk migration but needs backfill script.
ada (legal): Also require opt-in for us to run canaries using synthetic traffic in low-traffic windows as condition of pin.
zoe (prod): Comms + contract ask: 9mo pin if they (a) supply eval bundle, (b) accept synthetic canaries, (c) accept latency SLA of +25ms OR pay additional 2 months of credits. Else we offer 6mo pin with standard terms.
ops-bot: alert: staging job tenant-pin-spike started ci-2026-05-11-2130.
arjun (eng): Action items: Ill prototype schema + API and open RFC by Tuesday. Estimate 2 dev sprints + 1 QA for safe rollout. Add migration job to surface expiring pins.
mira (eng-ml): I'll draft eval runner changes and threshold configs. Need example prompts + labels from customer to finalize metrics.
nate (cs): I'll negotiate latency target and credits. Also request console editability and exportable audit CSV.
zoe (prod): OK owners set. Well present conditional offer to customer by EOD Fri. Marking owners: @arjun, @mira, @nate, @ada. :white_check_mark:
